headline: IMF warns an AI bubble could threaten global financial stability
summary: The IMF warned that a crash in AI-related valuations could ripple across markets and threaten global financial stability, citing high valuations, mounting debt, and cyberattacks as risk factors. Its report examines how financing behind the global AI buildout could trigger contagion if the industry fails to deliver the profits it has promised.
